teaser: A talk as a timeline that plays on a clock: slides, builds, animations and a recorded demo, with a player built and tested for tonight.
core_idea: A short talk can be completely scripted: a timeline of beats, each with a slide and the words to say, played on a clock by one HTML file, with builds, a terminal that prints the recorded output of the real run, tables, video and a presenter view, and a rehearsal mode that records planned against actual times; it grows out of the Black Hat Europe 2025 deck, whose slides are data in a vault, and the VoiceDebrief pitch, which added timings and a presenter; animations made as code, in Claude Motion, Manim or Remotion, fit the same timeline; the first use is the five-minute demo for ruv.sgit.ai at Agentic Engineering Live with rUv in London.
